_welcome.title: Welcome to {brand}!
_welcome.description: Let us show you around the most important features so you can get started quickly. It only takes a few minutes.

_modules_setup.title: Set up your {brand}
_modules_setup.description: Here you choose which modules to use. The core features are on. Turn on extras such as prepaid packages, tasks or integrations. You can always change this later under Settings → Modules.

hjem-prompt.title: Write what you did
hjem-prompt.description: Home is your start page. Type e.g. “2 hours on the website for Jensen” and press Enter. {brand} suggests the client, project and time, and you confirm before anything is saved. Press / to jump here.

hjem-hurtigstart.title: Start a timer with one click
hjem-hurtigstart.description: Your most used projects are ready here. One click starts the timer, or continue your latest entry.

nav-overblik.title: Overview
nav-overblik.description: Numbers, revenue, tasks and prepaid packages gathered in widgets. Find it in the menu or with G → O.

dashboard-widgets.title: Widgets
dashboard-widgets.description: The overview is built from widgets. You can see the weekly summary, earnings, active projects and much more.

dashboard-edit-btn.title: Customise your overview
dashboard-edit-btn.description: Click here to add, remove and move widgets so the overview fits your workflow.

time-tracking-bar.title: The timer follows you
time-tracking-bar.description: The time tracking bar is always visible at the top. Start by choosing a project and track your time no matter which page you are on.

timer-start-btn.title: Start and stop
timer-start-btn.description: Press here to start the timer, or use the keyboard shortcut T for quick start/stop.

timer-project-select.title: Choose a project
timer-project-select.description: Choose which project you are tracking time on. The hourly rate is taken automatically from the project or the client.

time-entries-list.title: Your time entries
time-entries-list.description: Here you find all your time entries. Edit, filter by date, and export to CSV.

time-view-toggle.title: Switch view
time-view-toggle.description: Switch between list view and weekly overview (timesheet). The weekly overview gives you a quick picture of your week.

tasks-board.title: Task management
tasks-board.description: Organise your work with a kanban board. Drag tasks between columns to update their status.

tasks-add-btn.title: Create tasks
tasks-add-btn.description: Add new tasks with one click. Set a deadline and priority and link them to a project.

tasks-view-toggle.title: Kanban or list
tasks-view-toggle.description: Switch between the kanban board and list view. Pick whichever suits you best.

clients-list.title: Your clients
clients-list.description: Manage clients with contact details, CVR lookup and individual hourly rates.

clients-add-btn.title: Add clients
clients-add-btn.description: Create new clients here. Use the CVR lookup to fetch company details automatically from the Danish CVR registry.

projects-list.title: Projects
projects-list.description: Every project belongs to a client. Set hourly rates, budgets and deadlines per project.

klippekort-list.title: Prepaid packages
klippekort-list.description: Prepaid packages are blocks of hours paid in advance. When you track time on a project with a prepaid package, it is deducted from the balance automatically.

klippekort-add-btn.title: Create a prepaid package
klippekort-add-btn.description: Create a new prepaid package here. Enter the number of hours and the hourly rate, and link it to a client.

invoices-list.title: Invoices
invoices-list.description: Create and manage invoices. You can generate invoices directly from your time entries.

invoices-actions.title: Create invoices
invoices-actions.description: Create a new invoice manually, or generate one automatically from unbilled time entries.

invoices-stats.title: Invoice overview
invoices-stats.description: Here you see the overall status: total invoiced, paid, outstanding and overdue amounts.

reports-page.title: Reports and analysis
reports-page.description: Analyse time and earnings with detailed reports, charts and export options.

settings-page.title: Settings
settings-page.description: Here you can update your profile, default hourly rate and weekly hours goal, and choose between a light and dark theme.

settings-sidebar.title: More settings
settings-sidebar.description: Explore the other settings: company profile, security, email integration, notifications, GDPR and much more.

_finish.title: You are ready!
_finish.description: You now know the most important features. Use Ctrl+K to search and navigate quickly. You can always restart the tour from the user menu.
